errors.evidence: The description states that the categories on the y-axis are sorted alphabetically, but they are actually sorted by their corresponding values on the x-axis in descending order.

errors.text_span: Die anderen sieben Balken variieren in ihrer Länge zwischen etwa 73 und 78
